name: Cognition & Swarm Intelligence
tagline: In-memory graph retrieval, SIMD vector search, and multi-algorithm swarm optimization.

projects.name: Hypertensor GraphRAG
projects.description: In-memory typed property-graph store with hybrid dense and BM25 retrieval. Dense search uses SIMD TensorPrimitives, with optional Level Zero GPU offload. It gives agents multi-hop graph context through a 65+ tool FastMCP server and a desktop HUD.

projects.name: HyperSwarm Optimization Suite
projects.description: Swarm optimization framework covering core, hybrid, advanced and multi-objective algorithms. It has Director-managed subswarm ensembles, convergence and diversity monitoring, Pareto-sorting threshold tuning, and a desktop visualizer.

projects.name: SwarmDev
projects.description: Deterministic prompt-to-workflow pipeline. It does intent classification, planning, knowledge-graph construction, frame routing, policy-gated normalization and diagnostics. Optional kGNN reasoning and wavescan layers are opt-in.

projects.name: SwarmBench
projects.description: Benchmarking, characterization, elimination tournaments and real-time visualization HUD running 34 optimization algorithms against 110 test functions with HyperCache config reuse and self-validating LaTeX/JSON profiles.

projects.name: Interactive PNN Decision Matrix
projects.description: Interactive diagram and browser-based visualization tool for probabilistic neural network decision matrices. Live on GitHub Pages.

name: Machine Learning & Acceleration
tagline: Agentic AI building blocks, zero-allocation LLM runners, and IPU-offloaded query engines.

projects.name: ML.Agentic (v1.0.0)
projects.description: 21 zero-dependency multi-agent architectural building blocks, MCP (Model Context Protocol), A2A (Agent2Agent), and JSON-RPC 2.0 for .NET 10 with sub-millisecond execution and 0 external dependencies.

projects.name: l0llm (v2.0.0)
projects.description: Ultra-fast, zero-allocation native LLM runner and OpenAI-compatible REST server in pure C# for Intel GPUs. Benchmarked at 41.3 tok/s on Iris Xe with zero GC allocations.

projects.name: HFLabs Machine Learning Suite
projects.description: Spiking neural networks, contextual and intergraph inference, and knowledge-graph embeddings (KGE). Hyperparameter optimization (Bayesian, Hyperband, BOHB, ASHA-BOHB, TuRBO) and graph-constrained beam decoding.

projects.name: Accelerator
projects.description: Unified hardware-accelerator layer. A gRPC service executes plan envelopes across IPU (Poplar), CUDA, OpenCL, Level Zero, FPGA and DMA/RDMA backends with compiled-graph caching.

projects.name: IPU SQL Query Acceleration (MVP)
projects.description: A PostgreSQL extension and a SQL Server CLR bridge offload aggregates (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX) and vector distance ops (cosine, dot, L2) to the IPU through a gRPC microservice.

name: Hardware & Native Substrates
tagline: Intel Level Zero GPU interop, diagnostics, Graphcore Poplar bindings, and header-to-binding generation.

projects.name: LevelZero.NET (v2.0.0)
projects.description: High-performance zero-allocation managed .NET 10 bindings for Intel oneAPI Level Zero runtime with pre-compiled SPIR-V and .zebin kernel catalogs across 11 Intel GPU architectures.

projects.name: l0check (v2.0.0)
projects.description: Fast standalone CLI diagnostic tool for inspecting Intel GPU architectures, driver capabilities, memory topologies, and validating compute kernel execution.

projects.name: Poplar.NET (v1.0.0-preview)
projects.description: World first zero-allocation C# / .NET 10 runtime engine and resident graph orchestration SDK for Graphcore Colossus IPUs (Bow-2000, MK2, IPU-POD).

projects.name: Poplar Explorer Fork
projects.description: Basic framework and interactive exploration workbench for rapid prototyping of Poplar programs on Graphcore IPUs.

projects.name: Abigen (in development)
projects.description: libclang-driven generator that reads C/C++ headers, emits reviewed/verified C# bindings, and manages upstream release tracking with fail-closed validation.
